# Ice Hockey — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where did Ice Hockey originate?", "Canada"),

    ("What is governing body?", "IIHF"),
]

        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
